name: basalt
description: Basalt, the SRA Syndicate design system.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/tokens && npm run build -w packages/react && node tools/html-skill/build.mjs
scripts.test: npm test -w packages/tokens && npm test -w packages/react && npm run test:html-skill && npm run test:brand
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run artifact && npm run typecheck:review && npm run test:packages
scripts.test:brand: npm run build -w packages/tokens && node --test brand/test/*.test.mjs
